item.description: Antimmachos #4888 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown. Antimmachos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: Antimmachos #4888 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown. Antimmachos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
